subject.title: Crestodian talk-to-agent command can miss the app handoff

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's host-owned exact `talk to agent` handoff boundary, or ask for a narrower handoff-only replacement before this issue closes?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix boundary sits at the deliberate AI-owned Crestodian chat versus deterministic host-navigation contract, and the current candidate PR also carries migration-sensitive changes.

options.title: Land the linked PR after review
options.body: Accept the included restart, handoff, and profile-isolation fixes once maintainer review is satisfied with the broader migration/security boundary.

options.title: Ask for a narrow replacement
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a smaller PR that only handles exact host-navigation selectors before the model path.

options.title: Keep model-owned handoff
options.body: Leave `talk to agent` dependent on the model emitting an open-agent directive and accept the current source-reproducible app handoff miss.

recommendation.title: Land the linked PR after review
recommendation.body: Accept the included restart, handoff, and profile-isolation fixes once maintainer review is satisfied with the broader migration/security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked fix PR and the relevant Crestodian/onboarding history found in blame and merged PR metadata.
